en: Board/executive-approved data governance charter (signed, dated); data governance policy document; mandate letter for Chief Data Officer or equivalent; governance framework version history showing annual review.
RACI matrix covering Data Owner, Data Steward, Data Custodian, and CDO roles; organisational chart showing data office placement; signed role-acceptance letters or HR job descriptions per role.
Data Governance Committee ToR (terms of reference); meeting minutes (minimum quarterly); escalation path document; integration evidence with enterprise risk and IT governance committees.
Policy register listing each data governance policy with owner, version, approval date, and next-review date; evidence that policies are published on the intranet and communicated to staff.

name_ar: تقديم التقييم الذاتي لمؤشر البيانات الوطني ومتابعة النضج
en: Completed NDMO NDI self-assessment submission for current year; gap analysis report against previous year's score; maturity improvement roadmap with milestones; NDI score trend dashboard screenshot.

name_ar: برنامج التوعية والتدريب على حوكمة البيانات
en: Annual training plan for data governance roles; completion records / LMS certificates for Data Owners and Stewards; awareness campaign materials; post-training assessment scores.

Screenshot/export of active data catalog tool listing all registered data assets with dataset name, owner, classification, and system of record; data asset inventory count vs. total known systems; gap closure plan for unregistered systems.
Published business glossary with term definitions, owners, and approval dates; metadata schema document specifying mandatory attributes per asset type; glossary coverage % across catalog assets.
Data lineage diagrams for critical data elements (CDEs) showing source-to-consumption path; lineage coverage % report for Tier-1 systems; evidence that lineage is updated on system changes.

name_en: NDI Data Asset Submission & Catalogue Registration
name_ar: تسجيل أصول البيانات في مؤشر البيانات الوطني وفهرسته
en: NDMO NDI portal submission receipts for all reportable datasets; mapping of internal catalog assets to NDI catalogue entries; NDI metadata completeness score per submitted dataset.
Monthly metadata completeness dashboard showing % of assets with all mandatory fields populated; automated metadata quality rules definition; trend chart over last 12 months; corrective action log.

Approved data quality framework document covering completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, and validity dimensions; DQ dimension definitions aligned to ISO 8000 or DAMA; DQ policy approval evidence.

CDE register listing each element with business owner, source system, quality dimension targets, and current scores; data profiling reports from profiling tool (e.g. Informatica, Talend, SQL queries) showing null rates, duplicate rates, format violations.

Data quality rules catalogue with rule ID, description, source system, and enforcement point; evidence of automated rule execution (scheduled job logs, pipeline validation reports); pass/fail rate trends per rule over 3 months.

Monthly DQ scorecard by domain showing dimension scores vs. targets; executive summary report presented to Data Governance Committee (meeting minutes evidence); historical trend chart (12 months); NDI data quality maturity rating documentation.

name_en: Data Quality Issue Management & Root-Cause Remediation
name_ar: إدارة مشكلات جودة البيانات ومعالجة الأسباب الجذرية
en: Issue register / ticketing system export showing open DQ issues with owner, severity, and age; root-cause analysis reports for recurring issues; evidence of process or system fixes applied; mean-time-to-resolve (MTTR) trend.
Approved DQ improvement roadmap aligned to NDI maturity targets; project charters or initiative briefs for each improvement initiative; progress tracking dashboard with milestone completion %.

name_ar: سياسة دورة حياة البيانات وجدول الاحتفاظ
en: Board-approved data lifecycle policy; retention schedule document listing each data asset class with retention period, legal basis, and disposal method; evidence of periodic review (version history).

Integration architecture diagram showing data flows between source systems; data integration standards document specifying API/file/streaming protocols; evidence of standards enforcement in project design reviews (review checklists signed by Data Architect).

name_ar: ضوابط تخزين البيانات والنسخ الاحتياطي والاسترداد
en: Storage architecture document; automated backup job logs with success/failure rates; tested recovery runbooks with last test date and RTO/RPO results; storage capacity monitoring dashboard.
Secure deletion policy and procedure document; data disposal request forms with approvals; certificate of destruction for hard media; audit log from data erasure tool; annual disposal audit report.

name_ar: مراقبة عمليات البيانات وتقارير اتفاقيات مستوى الخدمة
en: Operations monitoring dashboard showing pipeline success rates, latency, and error counts; SLA definition document per data pipeline; monthly SLA compliance report; incident log for pipeline failures.

name_ar: سياسة إدارة الوثائق ونظام التصنيف التدرجي
en: Approved document management policy; document taxonomy / filing structure document; DMS tool configuration screenshot showing taxonomy in use; governance committee approval evidence.

name_ar: ضبط إصدارات الوثائق وسير عمل الاعتماد
en: DMS version history report for a sample of controlled documents; approval workflow configuration screenshots; evidence that superseded versions are archived not deleted; change log per document.

Records retention schedule aligned to Saudi National Archives Authority requirements; legal hold register listing active holds with legal basis and scope; evidence of hold notifications to custodians.
DMS search configuration evidence (full-text indexing enabled); user satisfaction survey results on content findability; metadata completeness report for DMS assets; accessibility audit report.
Approved enterprise data architecture strategy document; data architecture principles register (min. 8 principles with rationale); evidence of architecture board endorsement.

Published conceptual data model covering all core business domains; logical data models for Tier-1 systems in the data modeling tool repository; model review records signed by Data Architect and Business Owner.

name_en: Data Architecture Review in Project Lifecycle
name_ar: مراجعة هندسة البيانات ضمن دورة حياة المشاريع
en: Architecture review checklist used in project SDLC gates; sample of architecture review decisions (approved/rejected) from last 12 months; evidence that non-compliant designs are tracked to resolution.
Current-state data ecosystem diagram showing all systems, data flows, and integration patterns; integration pattern standards document; evidence of annual architecture map update.
Approved data technology standards register (databases, ETL, BI, cataloging tools); evidence of standards enforcement in procurement and project approval; annual review of technology radar.

name_ar: تحديد نطاقات البيانات الرئيسية وتحديد ملاكها
en: Master data domain register listing each domain (e.g. Customer, Supplier, Employee, Asset, Location) with assigned Data Owner and Steward; business justification for each domain's criticality classification.

name_ar: إدارة السجل الذهبي ومنصة البيانات الرئيسية
en: MDM platform architecture document; golden-record definition per domain (matching rules, survivorship rules); duplicate detection rate report; golden-record adoption % in consuming systems.

name_ar: حوكمة البيانات المرجعية وإدارة قوائم الترميز
en: Reference data registry listing all code lists with owner, source authority (e.g. SAMA, GAZT, NDMO national classifications), and last-review date; change request log for reference data updates; evidence of synchronisation with national/sector reference standards.
Monthly MDM data quality scorecard per domain showing duplicate rate, completeness, and match confidence; reconciliation report between MDM hub and downstream systems; data steward sign-off evidence.
MDM integration architecture diagram showing all publishing and subscribing systems; synchronisation SLA document per domain; latency monitoring dashboard; exception handling procedure.
BI governance policy document; BI center-of-excellence or analytics team charter; report ownership register listing each certified report with owner and approval date.

name_en: Data Warehouse & Analytical Data Store Management
en: Data warehouse architecture document; model documentation for fact and dimension tables; change management log for warehouse schema changes; data freshness SLA report.

Self-service analytics platform access control policy; training completion records for self-service users; certified dataset register available to self-service users; data literacy programme materials.
Report reconciliation procedure document; sample reconciliation test results for top-5 management reports; UAT sign-off records for new reports before production deployment.

name_en: AI & Advanced Analytics Ethics and Governance
name_ar: أخلاقيات وحوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي والتحليلات المتقدمة
en: AI/ML model inventory register with model owner, purpose, and risk classification; ethical AI review checklist applied to each model before production; bias assessment report for high-risk models; alignment documentation with SDAIA AI Ethics Principles.
Board-approved data security policy; technical data security standards document covering encryption, masking, access, and DLP; evidence of annual policy review; alignment mapping to NCA ECC controls.

name_en: Data Access Control & Privileged User Management
name_ar: ضبط الوصول للبيانات وإدارة المستخدمين المميزين
en: Role-based access control (RBAC) matrix for critical data stores; quarterly access recertification report signed by Data Owners; privileged access review log; segregation of duties conflict report.

Encryption standards document specifying algorithms and key lengths per classification level; encryption coverage report for data at rest and in transit; data masking configuration for non-production environments; key management procedure document.
DLP tool deployment scope document; DLP policy rule set configuration export; monthly DLP incident report showing policy violation counts by severity; evidence of DLP rule tuning based on incidents.

name_en: Data Security Incident Response & Breach Notification
name_ar: الاستجابة لحوادث أمن البيانات وإخطار الاختراق
en: Data security incident response procedure; data breach notification workflow showing NDMO/SDAIA notification path and timelines; sample incident report (anonymised) showing containment and notification steps; breach drill exercise report.
Board-approved data sharing policy; data sharing request and approval procedure; data sharing register listing active sharing arrangements with counterparty, purpose, legal basis, and expiry date.

name_en: Data Sharing Agreements (DSAs) & Legal Basis Documentation
en: Signed DSA or MOU for each active sharing arrangement; legal basis assessment document per arrangement (citing Personal Data Protection Law article where personal data is involved); DSA renewal calendar.

name_ar: معايير قابلية التشغيل البيني وحوكمة واجهات برمجة التطبيقات
en: Interoperability standards document (e.g. NDMO data exchange standards, Saudi GOV-API guidelines); API catalogue listing all published APIs with version, owner, and consumer list; API design review gate evidence.

name_ar: التكامل مع منصة تبادل البيانات الوطنية
en: NDP integration architecture diagram; list of datasets onboarded to NDP with metadata completeness scores; NDP portal connection test evidence; data quality certification before NDP publication.

name_en: Data Sharing Audit Trail & Usage Monitoring
name_ar: مسار التدقيق على مشاركة البيانات ومراقبة الاستخدام
en: Audit log export for data sharing API calls (last 90 days); anomaly detection report for unusual sharing volumes; annual review of sharing arrangements by Data Governance Committee (minutes).

Approved data value framework document defining value categories (operational, commercial, social); benefits realisation register for data initiatives with baseline, target, and actual KPIs; annual data value report presented to leadership.

name_ar: سجل فرص تحقيق الدخل من البيانات والابتكار
en: Data monetisation opportunity register with each initiative's description, owner, stage, and estimated value; evidence of board/executive review; privacy and security impact assessment for monetisation initiatives involving personal data.

name_ar: برنامج محو أمية البيانات وثقافة البيانات
en: Data literacy strategy document; training curriculum by role; completion rate report (% of staff completing each tier of training); data culture survey results (annual) with trend; champions network membership list.

name_en: Data Innovation Lab & Pilot Programme Governance
name_ar: حوكمة مختبر ابتكار البيانات وبرنامج الحالات التجريبية
en: Data innovation lab (or sandbox) governance document; pilot project register with hypothesis, dataset used, privacy safeguards applied, and outcome; stage-gate review evidence for pilots progressing to production.
Board-approved open data policy; open data publication strategy with dataset prioritisation criteria; evidence of alignment with data.gov.sa or sector-specific portal requirements.

name_en: Open Data Dataset Register & Quality Certification
name_ar: سجل مجموعات البيانات المفتوحة وشهادة الجودة
en: Open data dataset register listing each published dataset with owner, format, licence, update frequency, and quality score; DQ certification checklist completed before publication; data portal publication confirmation.

name_en: Open Data Licensing & Intellectual Property Management
name_ar: ترخيص البيانات المفتوحة وإدارة الملكية الفكرية
en: Licence assignment record per dataset (e.g. Saudi Open Data Licence terms); IP review evidence confirming no third-party IP conflicts; legal opinion for datasets with potential commercial sensitivity.

name_en: Open Data Portal Maintenance & User Engagement
name_ar: صيانة بوابة البيانات المفتوحة والتفاعل مع المستخدمين
en: Portal availability and uptime report (monthly); dataset download and API usage statistics; user feedback / issue tracker for data quality reports from portal users; evidence of issue resolution.

name_en: Open Data Impact Assessment & Value Reporting
name_ar: تقييم أثر البيانات المفتوحة وإعداد تقارير القيمة
en: Annual open data impact report covering dataset downloads, known reuse cases, and estimated economic/social value; survey results from data ecosystem stakeholders on open data usefulness.

name_ar: سياسة حرية المعلومات والتوافق مع الإطار القانوني
en: Approved FOI/information access policy document citing applicable legislation; roles and responsibilities document for FOI handling; evidence of policy publication on entity website.

name_ar: سجل طلبات حرية المعلومات ومتابعة الردود
en: FOI request register export showing all requests received in the period with date received, request type, assigned handler, response date, and outcome (disclosed/partially disclosed/refused); on-time response rate KPI.

name_ar: تقييم استثناءات حرية المعلومات وتوثيق الرفض
en: Exemption assessment template with exemption categories and harm test; sample refusal letters with exemption grounds cited; appeals register; legal review sign-off for complex refusals.

name_ar: التقارير السنوية وتقييم أداء حرية المعلومات
en: Annual FOI performance report covering request volumes, response rates, exemption statistics, and appeal outcomes; evidence of report submission to relevant oversight body; improvement plan addressing identified gaps.
DPO appointment letter or equivalent role charter; DPO contact details published on entity website; privacy governance committee ToR; annual DPO report to board/leadership.

ROPA spreadsheet/system export listing each processing activity with controller details, purpose, categories of data subjects and data, legal basis, retention period, and third-party transfers; evidence of quarterly ROPA review and update.

Consent management platform configuration or consent register showing consent records with timestamp, version of consent text, and opt-out records; lawful basis assessment document per processing activity citing PDPL article; privacy notice review record.

name_ar: إدارة حقوق أصحاب البيانات (آلية طلبات الوصول)
en: DSAR procedure document covering all PDPL rights (access, correction, deletion, portability, objection); DSAR request register with receipt date, right exercised, response date, and outcome; on-time response rate vs. PDPL statutory deadline.

DPIA procedure and threshold assessment criteria; completed DPIAs for high-risk processing activities (last 12 months); DPO sign-off records on each DPIA; evidence that DPIA findings are tracked to remediation.

name_ar: ضوابط نقل البيانات عبر الحدود والأطراف الثالثة
en: Third-party processor agreements (DPA clauses) for all vendors processing personal data on behalf of the entity; cross-border transfer risk assessment for transfers outside KSA citing PDPL adequacy or safeguards; vendor due-diligence checklist.

name_en: Personal Data Breach Management & NDMO Notification
name_ar: إدارة خروقات البيانات الشخصية والإخطار للمكتب الوطني
en: Personal data breach response procedure with NDMO notification workflow and timeline (72-hour target); breach register with severity classification, notification dates, and lessons learned; annual breach simulation exercise report.

name_en: Data Classification Policy & Four-Level Scheme Adoption
name_ar: سياسة تصنيف البيانات واعتماد النظام الرباعي
en: Board-approved data classification policy citing the four classification levels: Top Secret (سري للغاية), Secret (سري), Restricted (محظور), and Public (عام); mapping of policy to NDMO Data Classification Standard and NCA ECC requirements; evidence of annual policy review.

Data classification procedure document with decision tree and worked examples per data type; labelling standards document specifying label format for structured data, documents, and emails; evidence of labelling tool deployment (e.g. Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels or equivalent).

name_ar: مخزون تصنيف أصول البيانات ونسبة التغطية
en: Classification inventory report showing % of data assets classified by level across all systems; unclassified asset remediation plan with target date; classification coverage trend (monthly).

name_ar: ضوابط الأمن والتعامل المنسجمة مع التصنيف
en: Security control matrix mapping each classification level to required technical controls (encryption, access restrictions, DLP rules, watermarking); evidence of controls applied per level in Tier-1 systems; exception register with risk acceptance sign-off.

Annual classification training completion records (% of staff by role); classification quick-reference card distributed to staff; phishing/classification scenario test results; awareness campaign evidence.

name_ar: عملية مراجعة التصنيف وإعادة التصنيف والرفع عنه
en: Reclassification/declassification request and approval procedure; reclassification request log with approver, rationale, and effective date; periodic review schedule (at least every 2 years) for Secret and Restricted assets.
